source: Written 2026-10-15 against the definitive list of that day, from the verified oracle text (Scryfall via carddb --verify, fetched 2026-10-15) for every card a scene shows or names; printed power and toughness from the same Scryfall objects (Kor Spiritdancer is 0/2, the only base stat a scene uses); Scryfall's rulings (Eriette of the Charmed Apple; Killian, Decisive Mentor; Killian, Ink Duelist; Sage's Reverie; Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor; Hateful Eidolon; Winds of Rath; Grievous Wound; Kor Spiritdancer; Coercive, Parasitic, Ghoulish and Martial Impetus; Sigil of the Empty Throne; Archon of Sun's Grace; Ethereal Armor; All That Glitters; Mesa Enchantress; Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice; Sram, Senior Edificer; Ghostly Prison; Hyena Umbra; Ashiok's Reaper; Darksteel Mutation; Starfield Mystic; Hero of Iroas) and this deck's notes. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. Commander starting life is 40 (CR 903.7); a player at 0 life loses (CR 704.5a). An Aura spell targets what it will enchant (CR 303.4a), so Killian, Ink Duelist's {2} comes off every Aura cast on a creature, and not off Grievous Wound, which enchants a player. You still control an Aura you put on an opponent's creature (CR 303.4e; Starfield Mystic, Pearl-Ear and All That Glitters rulings), so it counts for Eriette's X, for Ethereal Armor and for Pearl-Ear's affinity (CR 702.41a); Eriette counts X as her trigger resolves (ruling). Discounts cut only generic mana (CR 118.7a; Killian, Ink Duelist and Hero of Iroas rulings), apply in any order and stop at {0} (CR 601.2f). Goad is CR 701.15a-b: the Impetus Auras and Redemption Arc goad through a static ability, so for as long as they stay attached (CR 611.3a-b), while Killian, Decisive Mentor's goad lasts until your next turn (CR 701.15a; his reminder text). A goaded creature that can't attack you attacks another player if able (goad rulings) and is never forced to pay Ghostly Prison's cost (CR 508.1d). A tapped creature can't block (CR 509.1a). Ghoulish Impetus returns without being cast, so you choose what it enchants (CR 303.4f). Sage's Reverie counts itself and Auras on any player's creatures (rulings). Hateful Eidolon counts an Aura that leaves with its creature (ruling; CR 603.10a), and that Aura goes to the graveyard as a state-based action (CR 704.5m), which is what Ashiok's Reaper sees. Cast triggers (Mesa Enchantress, Kor Spiritdancer, Sram, Sigil of the Empty Throne) resolve before the spell, even if it's countered (rulings; CR 113.7a). Light-Paws triggers only on an Aura that was cast and entered (oracle text), and an Aura that can't be attached to her stays in the library (ruling). Grievous Wound's trigger resolves after the damage, once per combat-damage event (rulings); Eriette's drain is life loss, not damage (CR 119.3, 120.3a), so it never triggers the Wound. Winds of Rath: a creature is enchanted if any Aura is attached to it (ruling). Umbra armor is mandatory (Hyena Umbra ruling).

scenes.head: Eriette of the Charmed Apple — Auras everywhere
scenes.sub: White-black Auras, 28 in the 99: put them on the table's creatures and on one threat of your own.
scenes.say: Eriette of the Charmed Apple. White-black Auras, twenty-eight of them in the ninety-nine. Put them on the table's creatures, and on one threat of your own.

scenes.head: Line one: creatures wearing your Auras can't attack you
scenes.sub: Each creature that's enchanted by an Aura you control can't attack you or planeswalkers you control. That includes their creatures.
scenes.say: Line one. Each creature that's enchanted by an Aura you control can't attack you, or planeswalkers you control. That includes their creatures wearing your Auras.

scenes.head: Line two: the drain
scenes.sub: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Auras you control.
scenes.say: Line two, the drain. At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Auras you control.

scenes.head: Auras on their creatures count
scenes.sub: You still control an Aura you put on an opponent's creature. Three Auras on three of their creatures: each opponent loses 3 at your end step.
scenes.say: Auras on their creatures count. You still control an Aura you put on an opponent's creature. Three Auras on three of their creatures, and each opponent loses three at your end step, while you gain three.

scenes.head: Plan one: goad or shut down
scenes.sub: [[Parasitic Impetus]] goads: it must attack someone else. [[Planar Disruption]]: no attacks, blocks or activated abilities. [[Darksteel Mutation]]: a 0/1 whose only ability is indestructible.
scenes.say: Plan one: goad their creatures, or shut them down. Parasitic Impetus goads one, so it has to attack someone other than you. Planar Disruption stops one attacking, blocking or using activated abilities. Darksteel Mutation makes one a zero-one whose only ability is indestructible.

scenes.head: Plan two: one threat of your own
scenes.sub: [[Kor Spiritdancer|Kor]] gets +2/+2 per Aura on it. [[Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice|Light-Paws]]: each Aura you cast can fetch another onto her, of equal or lower mana value.
scenes.say: Plan two: one threat of your own. Kor Spiritdancer gets plus two plus two for each Aura attached to it. And each time an Aura you cast enters, Light-Paws can put another from your library onto herself, with equal or lower mana value and a different name.

scenes.head: Every Aura you cast draws
scenes.sub: [[Mesa Enchantress]] draws on each enchantment spell, [[Kor Spiritdancer|Kor]] and [[Sram, Senior Edificer|Sram]] on each Aura spell. All three out: one Aura, three cards.
scenes.say: Every Aura you cast draws. Mesa Enchantress draws on each enchantment spell, and Kor Spiritdancer and Sram, Senior Edificer on each Aura spell. With all three out, one Aura is three cards.

scenes.head: Enchant their creatures. Drain the table. Grow one threat.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: the discounts, goad, the card engine, and how the deck wins.
scenes.say: Enchant their creatures. Drain the table. Grow one threat. Four clips follow: the discounts, goad, the card engine, and how the deck wins.

scenes.head: Every Aura targets
scenes.sub: An Aura spell targets what it will enchant. [[Killian, Ink Duelist]]: spells you cast that target a creature cost {2} less. That's every Aura cast on a creature.
scenes.say: Every Aura targets. An Aura spell targets what it will enchant, and Killian, Ink Duelist makes spells you cast that target a creature cost two less. That's every Aura you cast on a creature, theirs or yours.

scenes.head: Four more take {1} off
scenes.sub: [[Transcendent Envoy|Envoy]], [[Hero of Iroas|Hero]] and [[Danitha Capashen, Paragon|Danitha]]: Aura spells cost {1} less. [[Starfield Mystic]]: enchantment spells. [[Codsworth, Handy Helper|Codsworth]] taps for {W}{W} for Aura and Equipment spells.
scenes.say: Four more take one off. Transcendent Envoy, Hero of Iroas and Danitha Capashen each make your Aura spells cost one less, and Starfield Mystic your enchantment spells. Codsworth taps for two white, spent only on Aura and Equipment spells.

scenes.head: [[Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor|Pearl-Ear]]: {1} off per Aura you control
scenes.sub: Enchantment spells you cast have affinity for Auras, and the Auras on their creatures count. With four out, [[Sigil of the Empty Throne|Sigil]] ({3}{W}{W}) costs {W}{W}.
scenes.say: Pearl-Ear, Imperial Advisor: one off for each Aura you control. Your enchantment spells have affinity for Auras, and the Auras on their creatures count. With four Auras out, Sigil of the Empty Throne costs just two white.

scenes.head: Generic mana only
scenes.sub: Discounts never pay a colored pip. [[Parasitic Impetus]] ({2}{B}) costs {B} with Killian, and still {B} with [[Transcendent Envoy|Envoy]] too. [[Grievous Wound]] targets a player: no Killian discount.
scenes.say: Generic mana only. Discounts never pay a colored pip. Parasitic Impetus costs two and a black; with Killian it's one black, and adding Envoy changes nothing. Grievous Wound targets a player, not a creature, so Killian doesn't discount it.

scenes.head: Turn 4: three Auras, four mana
scenes.sub: [[Killian, Ink Duelist|Killian]] came down on turn 2, [[Eriette of the Charmed Apple|Eriette]] on turn 3. Four lands, three Auras in hand.
scenes.say: Turn four: three Auras for four mana. Killian came down on turn two, and Eriette on turn three. Four lands, and three Auras in hand.

scenes.head: Two goad Auras for {B} each
scenes.sub: [[Parasitic Impetus]] and [[Coercive Impetus]] cost {2}{B}; Killian takes the {2}. One goes on each of two opponents' best creatures.
scenes.say: Two goad Auras, for one black mana each. Parasitic Impetus and Coercive Impetus cost two and a black, and Killian takes off the two. One goes on each of two opponents' best creatures.

scenes.head: [[Sage's Reverie]] for {1}{W}: draw three
scenes.sub: Killian takes {2} off its {3}{W}. On Eriette, it draws a card for each Aura you control on a creature: both Impetus Auras, and itself.
scenes.say: Then Sage's Reverie, for two. Killian takes two off its four. On Eriette, it draws a card for each Aura you control that's attached to a creature: both Impetus Auras, and itself. Three cards.

scenes.head: End step: each opponent loses 3
scenes.sub: Three Auras: [[Eriette of the Charmed Apple|Eriette]] drains 3 from each opponent, and you gain 3. Those Auras cost 10 as printed. You paid 4.
scenes.say: End step. Three Auras, so each opponent loses three, and you gain three. Those three Auras cost ten mana as printed. You paid four.

scenes.head: Goad: they attack, someone else if able
scenes.sub: A goaded creature attacks each combat if able, and attacks a player other than the one who goaded it if able.
scenes.say: Goad. A goaded creature attacks each combat if able, and it attacks a player other than the one who goaded it, if able.

scenes.head: Five Auras goad, for as long as they stay
scenes.sub: [[Parasitic Impetus|Parasitic]], [[Coercive Impetus|Coercive]], [[Ghoulish Impetus|Ghoulish]] and [[Martial Impetus]], and [[Redemption Arc]]. [[Killian, Decisive Mentor]]'s goad lasts until your next turn.
scenes.say: Five Auras goad, for as long as they stay on: Parasitic, Coercive, Ghoulish and Martial Impetus, and Redemption Arc. Killian, Decisive Mentor's goad lasts only until your next turn.

scenes.head: [[Eriette of the Charmed Apple|Eriette]]: and it can't attack you
scenes.sub: A creature wearing your Aura can't attack you at all. Goad makes it attack each combat if able, so it attacks someone else.
scenes.say: And with Eriette out, a creature wearing your Aura can't attack you at all. Goad makes it attack each combat if able, so it attacks someone else.

scenes.head: Their turn: it attacks someone else
scenes.sub: Opponent 1's creature, wearing your [[Parasitic Impetus]], attacks Opponent 2. Parasitic: Opponent 1 loses 2 life, and you gain 2.
scenes.say: On their turn, it attacks someone else. Opponent one's creature, wearing your Parasitic Impetus, attacks opponent two. Parasitic triggers: opponent one loses two life, and you gain two.

scenes.head: [[Killian, Decisive Mentor|Killian]] and [[Coercive Impetus|Coercive]] draw
scenes.sub: Killian: whenever one or more creatures wearing your Auras attack, draw a card. Coercive: whenever its creature attacks, draw and lose 1 life. Together: two cards.
scenes.say: Killian, Decisive Mentor draws you a card whenever one or more creatures wearing your Auras attack, on their turns too. Coercive Impetus draws one more each time its creature attacks, for one life. That attack is two cards.

scenes.head: One Aura, two creatures goaded
scenes.sub: [[Martial Impetus]] goads the creature it enchants. When it enters, [[Killian, Decisive Mentor|Killian]] taps and goads another until your next turn. Tapped, it can't block you.
scenes.say: One Aura, two creatures goaded. Martial Impetus goads the creature it enchants. When it enters, Killian taps up to one target creature and goads it until your next turn. Tapped, it can't block your attack this turn.

scenes.head: Ghoulish returns; Redemption Arc exiles
scenes.sub: [[Ghoulish Impetus|Ghoulish]] returns to the battlefield at the next end step after its creature dies. [[Redemption Arc]]: {1}{W} exiles the creature it goads.
scenes.say: Ghoulish Impetus gives deathtouch, and when its creature dies, it returns to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step, on a creature you choose. Redemption Arc makes a creature indestructible and goaded, and one and a white exiles it when you're ready.

scenes.head: The rest pay to attack you
scenes.sub: [[Eriette of the Charmed Apple|Eriette]] stops every creature wearing your Aura. [[Ghostly Prison]] taxes the others: {2} for each creature attacking you.
scenes.say: The rest pay to attack you. Eriette stops every creature wearing your Aura, and Ghostly Prison taxes the others: two mana for each creature attacking you.

scenes.head: One Aura spell, three cards
scenes.sub: [[Mesa Enchantress|Mesa]] may draw on each enchantment spell, and [[Kor Spiritdancer|Kor]] on each Aura spell. [[Sram, Senior Edificer|Sram]] draws on each Aura or Equipment spell.
scenes.say: One Aura spell, three cards. Mesa Enchantress may draw on each enchantment spell you cast, and Kor Spiritdancer on each Aura spell. Sram draws on each Aura or Equipment spell.

scenes.head: [[Sage's Reverie]] counts their creatures too
scenes.sub: When it enters, draw one for each Aura you control on a creature, itself included. Three on their creatures plus Reverie: four cards.
scenes.say: Sage's Reverie counts their creatures too. When it enters, you draw a card for each Aura you control that's attached to a creature, itself included. Three goad Auras on their creatures, plus the Reverie on Eriette: four cards.

scenes.head: Their creature dies wearing your Aura: draw two
scenes.sub: [[Hateful Eidolon]] draws one for each Aura you controlled on it. Then the Aura hits the graveyard, and [[Ashiok's Reaper]] draws for that.
scenes.say: Their creature dies wearing your Aura, and you draw two. Hateful Eidolon draws a card for each Aura you controlled on it. Then the Aura goes to the graveyard, and Ashiok's Reaper draws a card for that.

scenes.head: [[Sigil of the Empty Throne|Sigil]]: an Angel per enchantment spell
scenes.sub: Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, create a 4/4 white Angel token with flying. Every Aura you cast brings one.
scenes.say: Sigil of the Empty Throne. Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you create a four-four white Angel with flying. Every Aura you cast brings one.

scenes.head: [[Archon of Sun's Grace|Archon]]: a Pegasus per enchantment
scenes.sub: Whenever an enchantment you control enters, create a 2/2 white Pegasus with flying. Your Pegasus creatures have lifelink.
scenes.say: Archon of Sun's Grace. Whenever an enchantment you control enters, you create a two-two white Pegasus with flying, and your Pegasus creatures have lifelink.

scenes.head: One [[Ethereal Armor]] for {W}: three cards and an Angel
scenes.sub: Cast it with Mesa, Kor, Sram and Sigil out. All four triggers resolve before the Armor does, even if it's countered.
scenes.say: One Ethereal Armor, for one white mana: three cards and an Angel. Cast it with Mesa Enchantress, Kor Spiritdancer, Sram and the Sigil out. All four triggers resolve before the Armor does, even if it's countered.

scenes.head: Two Auras that replace themselves
scenes.sub: [[Angelic Gift]] gives flying and [[Rune of Mortality]] deathtouch, and each draws a card when it enters.
scenes.say: Two Auras that replace themselves. Angelic Gift gives flying, Rune of Mortality gives deathtouch, and each one draws a card when it enters.

scenes.head: Cast the engines first
scenes.sub: With [[Mesa Enchantress|Mesa]], [[Kor Spiritdancer|Kor]] and [[Sram, Senior Edificer|Sram]] out, every Aura you cast replaces itself before it even resolves.
scenes.say: Cast the engines first. With Mesa Enchantress, Kor Spiritdancer and Sram out, every Aura you cast replaces itself before it even resolves.

scenes.head: The drain grows with every Aura
scenes.sub: X counts every Aura you control, wherever it is. Six Auras: each of three opponents loses 6 at your end step, and you gain 6.
scenes.say: The drain grows with every Aura. X counts every Aura you control: on their creatures, on yours, and on a player. Six Auras, and each of three opponents loses six at every one of your end steps, while you gain six.

scenes.head: One threat: [[Kor Spiritdancer]]
scenes.sub: +2/+2 for each Aura on it. [[Ethereal Armor]]: +1/+1 per enchantment you control, and first strike. [[Angelic Destiny]]: +4/+4, flying and first strike.
scenes.say: One threat: Kor Spiritdancer. It gets plus two plus two for each Aura attached to it. Ethereal Armor adds plus one plus one for each enchantment you control, and first strike. Angelic Destiny adds plus four plus four, flying and first strike.

scenes.head: Six Auras out: a 14-power flier
scenes.sub: Two on Kor, three on their creatures, [[Grievous Wound]] on Opponent 1, and no other enchantments. Kor: +4. Armor: +6. Destiny: +4.
scenes.say: Six Auras out: a fourteen-power flier. Two on Kor Spiritdancer, three on their creatures, and Grievous Wound on opponent one, with no other enchantments. Kor's own ability gives plus four, the Armor plus six, and Angelic Destiny plus four.

scenes.head: [[Grievous Wound]]: every hit halves them
scenes.sub: They can't gain life, and lose half their life, rounded up, whenever dealt damage. At 26, a 14-point hit leaves 12; the Wound takes 6 more.
scenes.say: Grievous Wound: every hit halves them. The enchanted player can't gain life, and whenever they're dealt damage, they lose half their life, rounded up. Opponent one is at twenty-six. Kor Spiritdancer flies in unblocked for fourteen: twelve left, then the Wound takes six more.

scenes.head: End step: [[Eriette of the Charmed Apple|Eriette]] finishes it
scenes.sub: Six Auras: Opponent 1 loses 6, down to 0. The others lose 6; you gain 6. Her drain is life loss, not damage: no Wound trigger.
scenes.say: End step: Eriette finishes it. Six Auras, so opponent one loses six, down to zero, and is out of the game. The others lose six, and you gain six. Her drain is life loss, not damage, so the Wound doesn't trigger on it.

scenes.head: [[Winds of Rath]]: only the unenchanted die
scenes.sub: Kor survives, and so do their creatures wearing your Auras. Your unenchanted creatures die too: enchant [[Eriette of the Charmed Apple|Eriette]] first.
scenes.say: Winds of Rath destroys all creatures that aren't enchanted. Kor Spiritdancer survives, and so do their creatures wearing your Auras, which still can't attack you. Your unenchanted creatures die too, so enchant Eriette first.

scenes.head: Keep the threat on the battlefield
scenes.sub: [[Swiftfoot Boots]]: hexproof. [[Timely Ward]]: indestructible, at instant speed on a commander. [[Hyena Umbra]]: if it would be destroyed, the Umbra goes instead.
scenes.say: Keep the threat on the battlefield. Swiftfoot Boots gives it hexproof. Timely Ward makes it indestructible, and you can cast it at instant speed on a commander. If a creature wearing Hyena Umbra would be destroyed, the Umbra is destroyed instead.

scenes.head: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
scenes.sub: Bracket 2 · 28 Auras · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Eriette of the Charmed Apple. Bracket two, with twenty-eight Auras. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
